skills.name: Bubble Gun

skills.detail: A mid-range attack with a Knockback effect that inflicts a SPD debuff. Then, creates a shield that blocks enemies' attacks and movement. The shield will disappear after it receives a certain amount of damage or after a certain amount of time passes. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
